name: scf_density_cuda
scope: Build-time CUDA lowering of canonical SCF plain and energy-weighted density TensorIR for ordinary HF/KS and DF-SCF. DF binds the same plain-density kernel with a runtime scalar weight and size_t dimensions. Canonical weights mirror only complete DF launch domains; other weights and clipped domains preserve full-square product orientation. Weighted density retains its qualified full-square FP64 multiplication order. Native code owns launches, streams, active masks, warm starts and solver state.
